summary: End-to-end verification of imported getsub storefront (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend pytest suite (16/16 passing) covers products listing/get/404, notify signup validation, admin auth (JWT + wrong-password 401 + missing token 401), full admin products CRUD, order creation in SIMULATED payment mode, buyer-token order lookup with account_password redacted, recharge credentials submission, chat POST/GET, and admin notify-signups list. Frontend Playwright covered landing (both product cards), /youtube product page with FAQ open, delivery-choice modal → savings modal → email validation → simulated checkout → /order/{token} page, /spotify recharge flow → credentials form → chat send/receive, admin /admin login (wrong pw error + correct pw dashboard), admin Products CRUD (create + delete via confirm dialog). Everything works end to end; auto-seeded products present.

issues: Copy still references 'Paddle' as the checkout provider in the 'How it works' step even though payments are intentionally SIMULATED for this preview build. Not a bug, but confusing for reviewers testing the preview.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes account_password to admin via /api/admin/orders (line 438 returns raw doc). Buyer view correctly strips it (buyer_order_view), but admin gets the plaintext password. Acceptable for this MVP flow (admin needs it to log in and top up the buyer's account) but should be flagged and ideally encrypted at rest.
One large server.py (~580 lines) — fine for MVP but split into routers/products.py, routers/orders.py, routers/admin.py once features grow.

Console shows a React hydration warning about <span> child of <option>. It originates from the preview environment's visual-editor instrumentation injecting x-excluded spans into every dynamic node — NOT from application source. Safe to ignore in preview; would not appear in a production build.
'How it works' copy on landing and /youtube, /spotify still says 'Checkout runs through Paddle' but payments are simulated. Consider hiding or rewording when in SIMULATED mode.
Admin login rate-limit is per-IP with 5 attempts / 15 min. In preview behind a shared proxy this could lock the whole tester pool; consider a manual reset endpoint or shorter window.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (landing, product page, buy flow with simulated payment, order page, recharge credentials + chat, admin login, admin products CRUD)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds YouTube Premium and Spotify Premium on startup when products collection is empty. Tests created TEST_ prefixed notify signup, orders, and one throwaway product (deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/ is the regression suite. Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. The delivery-choice modal appears only for plans with multiple delivery_types (monthly + annual). Shared plans skip it and go straight to SavingsModal. Order buyer_email is lowercased server-side, so assert against lowercase.
